About This Book / 关于本书

Fundamentals of Software Engineering (O’Reilly, 2025) is written by Nathaniel (Nate) Schutta, a software architect and Java Champion focused on cloud computing and developer happiness, and Dan Vega, a Spring developer advocate at Broadcom and Java Champion with over 20 years of experience. The book goes beyond “just coding” to cover the full lifecycle of a software engineer: reading and writing code, modeling, automated testing, UI design, working with data, software architecture, deployment to production, productivity, learning how to learn, soft skills, career management, and the AI-powered engineer.

《软件工程基础：从编码到工程》（Fundamentals of Software Engineering，O’Reilly，2025）由 Nathaniel（Nate）Schutta 与 Dan Vega 合著。Nate 是软件架构师、Java Champion，专注于云计算与开发者幸福感；Dan Vega 是 Broadcom 的 Spring 开发者布道师、Java Champion，拥有 20 余年软件开发经验。本书超越“单纯写代码”，系统覆盖软件工程师的完整生命周期：阅读与编写代码、建模、自动化测试、UI 设计、数据处理、软件架构、走向生产环境、生产力、学会学习、软技能、职业管理，以及 AI 赋能的工程师。
